title: Extract global state into a Go struct
description: A Go counter package uses package-level globals and bare functions. Refactor to use a Counter struct with methods. Tests verify the struct API.

task_spec.prompt:
Refactor counter.go to use a Counter struct instead of package-level globals.

1. Define a Counter struct with private fields for the count value and step size.
2. Add a NewCounter(step int) *Counter constructor.
3. Move Increment, Decrement, Reset, Value as methods on *Counter.
4. Remove all package-level var declarations.

The tests use NewCounter(step) — make that constructor work correctly.

Run `go test ./...` to verify all 3 tests pass.
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `go test ./...` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.
